from common import *
import gzip


def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    assert TMP == Path('/private/tmp/qlib-quantile-n-20261107.5g5nkn20')
    assert not TMP.is_symlink()
    assert read(STATE)['status'] == 'stopping'
    assert read(BASE / 'docs/final-numerical-verification.json')['status'] == 'complete'
    process_audit = read(BASE / 'docs/process-and-mlflow-audit.json')
    assert not process_audit['task_processes_active']
    assert not process_audit['mlflow_metadata_modified_since_campaign_start']
    plan = read(BASE / 'docs/result-cleanup-dry-run.json')
    assert not plan['errors'] and not plan['delete_result_dirs'] and not plan['delete_mlruns_dirs']
    assert plan['only_result'] and plan['result_retention'] == 'platform'
    manifest = BASE / 'docs/temporary-artifact-inventory.json'
    if not manifest.exists():
        expected_pickles = set()
        for year in range(2020, 2027):
            receipt = read(BASE / 'docs' / f'inference-input-{year}.json')['cache']
            check(receipt)
            expected_pickles.add(Path(receipt['path']).name)
            for variant in VARIANTS:
                for item in read(BASE / 'docs' / f'inference-{variant}-{year}.json')['predictions']:
                    check(item['prediction_part'])
                    expected_pickles.add(Path(item['prediction_part']['path']).name)
        receipt = read(BASE / 'docs/evaluation-inputs.json')['cache']
        check(receipt)
        expected_pickles.add(Path(receipt['path']).name)
        files = sorted(p for p in TMP.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in TMP.rglob('*'))
        assert {p.name for p in files if p.suffix == '.pkl'} == expected_pickles
        assert len(expected_pickles) == 7 * sum(j["status"] == "succeeded" for j in read(PROGRESS)["jobs"]) + 8
        scripts = {p.stem for p in files if p.suffix == '.py'}
        entries, texts = [], {}
        for p in files:
            if p.suffix == '.py':
                source = BASE / 'docs' / f'adapter-{p.stem}.json'
                assert source.is_file(), f'Unarchived script: {p}'
                record = read(source)
                assert record['source'] == fingerprint(p) and record['source_text'] == p.read_text()
                role = 'temporary executable; exact source retained in adapter audit'
            elif p.suffix == '.pkl':
                role = 'derived inference/label cache or yearly prediction part; receipt verified, canonical consolidated predictions and frozen provider retained'
            elif p.suffix == '.pyc':
                assert p.parent.name == '__pycache__' and p.name.split('.')[0] in scripts
                role = 'rebuildable bytecode for archived temporary source'
            elif p.suffix in ['.log', '.json', '.jsonl']:
                assert p.parent == TMP
                texts[p.name] = p.read_text()
                role = 'execution text preserved in compressed audit'
            else:
                assert p.name == 'stop-monitor'
                role = 'completed monitor stop sentinel'
            entries.append({**fingerprint(p), 'role': role})
        archive = BASE / 'docs/runtime-texts.json.gz'
        with gzip.open(archive, 'wt', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            json.dump(texts, handle, ensure_ascii=False)
        inventory = {
            'at': time.time(), 'temporary_directory': str(TMP), 'entries': entries,
            'file_count': len(entries), 'bytes': sum(r['size'] for r in entries),
            'runtime_archive': fingerprint(archive),
            'ownership': 'Dedicated task directory created for this campaign. Pickles matched all existing canonical receipts; executable bytes matched archived source; remaining files are task logs, dispatch JSON, bytecode or the monitor sentinel.',
            'reference_policy': 'Temporary paths in inference/source receipts remain immutable historical provenance. Final models, consolidated predictions, label datasets, canonical evaluations, provider and shared-cache research reference are outside this directory and retained.',
            'recovery': 'Inventory is persisted before deletion. Recreate exact common.py and cleanup_temporary_v2.py from adapter source_text if interrupted, run with python -B, and resume this inventory without replacing it. After the directory is absent, use the official harness CLI and the persistent cleanup audit to close; do not recreate event files in the deleted directory.',
        }
        write(manifest, inventory)
    else:
        inventory = read(manifest)
        assert inventory['temporary_directory'] == str(TMP)
        check(inventory['runtime_archive'])
    expected = {Path(r['path']) for r in inventory['entries']}
    actual = {p for p in TMP.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert actual <= expected, f'Unexpected task files: {actual - expected}'
    assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in TMP.rglob('*'))
    log_path = BASE / 'docs/temporary-cleanup-progress.json'
    actions = read(log_path) if log_path.exists() else {'deleted': [], 'already_absent_on_resume': []}
    for receipt in inventory['entries']:
        p = Path(receipt['path'])
        assert p.is_relative_to(TMP) and not p.is_symlink()
        if p.exists():
            check(receipt)
            p.unlink()
            actions['deleted'].append(str(p))
        elif str(p) not in actions['deleted']:
            actions['already_absent_on_resume'].append(str(p))
        write(log_path, actions)
    for directory in sorted((p for p in TMP.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), key=lambda p: len(p.parts), reverse=True):
        directory.rmdir()
    TMP.rmdir()
    assert not TMP.exists()
    audit = {
        'result': 'no_changes', 'mlruns': 'not_applicable', 'temporary': 'cleaned',
        'completed_at': time.time(), 'temporary_directory_removed': str(TMP),
        'temporary_file_count': inventory['file_count'], 'temporary_bytes_removed': inventory['bytes'],
        'inventory': fingerprint(manifest), 'runtime_archive': inventory['runtime_archive'],
        'deletion_log': fingerprint(log_path), 'result_plan': fingerprint(BASE / 'docs/result-cleanup-dry-run.json'),
        'retention_review': fingerprint(BASE / 'docs/result-retention-review.json'),
        'process_and_mlflow_audit': fingerprint(BASE / 'docs/process-and-mlflow-audit.json'),
        'result_decision': 'Platform retention dry-run has zero deletion candidates; all existing result directories preserved, including all successful study models and prediction/provider dependencies. Historical missing-source warnings retained without retraining.',
        'mlruns_decision': 'All successful study save_session links point to local result artifacts; no MLflow metadata changed since campaign start, and save_session creates no recorder. No MLflow deletion required.',
        'temporary_decision': 'Only the exact persisted inventory of task-owned temporary files was removed. Source text, logs, required research data and model/prediction dependencies remain.',
    }
    write(BASE / 'docs/harness-cleanup.json', audit)
    progress = read(PROGRESS)
    progress['status'] = 'research_complete_pending_native_close'
    progress['cleanup'] = fingerprint(BASE / 'docs/harness-cleanup.json')
    write(PROGRESS, progress)
    print(json.dumps({'temporary_removed': str(TMP), 'files': inventory['file_count'], 'GiB': inventory['bytes'] / 1024**3, 'result': 'no_changes', 'mlruns': 'not_applicable'}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
purpose: Exact temporary adapter source; remove executable at close, retain reconstructable audit.
